fetchPrice().notice: Returns the latest price obtained from the Oracle. Called by Zero functions that require a current price.         It uses the main price feed and fallback to the backup one in case of an error. If both fail return the last         good price seen. Function will rever if got false success flag from the medianizer contract.

setAddress(uint8,address).notice: Allows users to setup the main and the backup price feeds

setOwner(address).notice: Set address of the owner (only owner can call this function)

userdoc.notice: The PriceFeed relies upon a main oracle and a secondary as a fallback in case of error
